Spark the Stampede.name: Spark the Stampede
Spark the Stampede.description: The user commits a sudden act of violence or wreckage in a crowded place: a smashed storefront, a fire set in a doorway, a blade raised in a packed station. Bystanders panic and scatter, and every hero, student or officer present must spend their next action protecting or evacuating civilians instead of attacking or chasing the user. Stamina: demanding.
